title: SoulSci
tagline: SoulSci is a public library platform with decentralized storage for users, using lighthouse
description:
SoulSci is an innovative platform that revolutionizes the traditional concept of public libraries. It is designed to offer users a new and unique experience by providing a decentralized storage system that is both secure and accessible. The platform leverages the power of lighthouse, a cutting-edge decentralized technology that enables users to store their digital content on a distributed network of computers.

SoulSci takes the traditional idea of a library and expands upon it to provide a wealth of information and resources for users, all in one place. With the decentralized storage system, users can feel confident in the security of their data and can access it from anywhere in the world, at any time. This eliminates the need for physical storage and provides users with an incredibly flexible and convenient way to store, access, and share their digital content.

Moreover, SoulSci's platform is designed to be user-friendly, intuitive and easily accessible to everyone. The platform's interface is designed to be simple and straightforward, allowing users to quickly find what they need. Additionally, the platform offers a rich and diverse collection of books, movies, music, and other digital content that can be easily accessed and enjoyed by users.

In conclusion, SoulSci is a cutting-edge platform that combines the best aspects of a public library with the latest advances in decentralized technology. By using lighthouse, SoulSci provides users with a safe and secure way to store and access their digital content, while also offering a wealth of information and resources that can be enjoyed by everyone. Whether you are a student, a professional, or just someone who loves to learn and explore, SoulSci has something for you.
how_its_made: This project uses WalletConnect and wagmi to retrieve user information from sign-in. We use Mongo DB and mongoose ORM for the database infrastructure to implement search functionality and easy access for users. Lighthouse is key to our design as it provides and guarantees permanent storage of files on-chain. The design came out quite well, really proud of our team.
